metadata.description: Firemoon Studio media utilities for Claude: fixed video and photo edits with no AI generation.

plugins.name: firemoon-video-crop
plugins.description: Center-crop short videos to portrait, square or landscape for Reels, Shorts and feeds.

plugins.name: firemoon-gif-studio
plugins.description: Turn up to five seconds of a short video into a looping GIF.

plugins.name: firemoon-speed-studio
plugins.description: Speed up or slow down short videos, with audio tempo matched.

plugins.name: firemoon-silent-cut
plugins.description: Remove the audio from short videos.

plugins.name: firemoon-clip-composer
plugins.description: Trim two to four short videos and join them in order.

plugins.name: firemoon-privacy-blur
plugins.description: Blur a fixed area of a short video, such as a licence plate or a screen.

plugins.name: firemoon-video-look-lab
plugins.description: Apply fixed colour presets to short videos.

plugins.name: firemoon-vertical-remix
plugins.description: Reframe short videos to 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 by cropping or padding.

plugins.name: firemoon-collage-studio
plugins.description: Arrange two to six photos into a grid, story or strip.

plugins.name: firemoon-retro-camera
plugins.description: Give photos a warm-film, monochrome or cool-chrome look.

plugins.name: firemoon-color-match
plugins.description: Correct the colour of photos: temperature, brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma.
